svg.aria-label: Survey bulletin: TEELQUUSKA 283B, class: Moss World. Inhabitants: three (3) hermit snails the size of cathedrals who hum in B-flat. Advisory: If you hear your name, it is not for you.
svg.title: TEELQUUSKA 283B — Outer Survey Office bulletin No. 4
svg.text: FORM PS-7 · DAILY PLANETARY BULLETIN · No. 4
Three (3) hermit snails the size of cathedrals
The oceans are on a timer.
⚠ If you hear your name, it is not for you.
“Took a sample. The sample took one of us.” —
